The '''DLS-12 heavy blaster carbine''' was a [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]] version of the larger [[DLT-19 heavy blaster rifle/Legends|DLT-19 heavy blaster rifle]] with a shortened barrel, reducing its range. The DLS-12 was designed by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] in the last [[Standard month/Legends|months]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and only saw limited use by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and later [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces. Typically, the DLS-12 was eschewed in favor of heavy [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]], though some specialized units preferred its shorter range and lower weight.<ref name="KtP" />

Costing 1,350 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], due to its limited use surplus [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] carbines ended up in arsenals across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="KtP" />
